license_expiring.title: Veeam ONE license on {host} expires soon
license_expiring.description:
The Veeam ONE license on **{host}** expires on {date}, in {days} days. Once it expires, Veeam ONE stops collecting data and this integration's sensors stop updating.

Install a renewed license in the Veeam ONE Client. This warning clears on its own once the new license is reported.

license_expired.title: Veeam ONE license on {host} has expired
license_expired.description:
The Veeam ONE license on **{host}** expired on {date}. Veeam ONE no longer collects data from the servers it monitors, so the values this integration reports are out of date.

Install a renewed license in the Veeam ONE Client. This warning clears on its own once the new license is reported.

resolve_alarm.name: Resolve alarm
resolve_alarm.description: Resolves triggered Veeam ONE alarms. Alarm IDs are listed in the alarms attribute of the Active alarms sensor.

config_entry_id.name: Veeam ONE server
config_entry_id.description: Server that raised the alarms. Needed only when more than one is configured.

alarm_ids.name: Alarm IDs
alarm_ids.description: IDs of the triggered alarms to resolve.
